claim: Autonomous QA/UX agent — no scripted navigation; harness verifies success id
goal: Complete the onboarding flow until the home-ready screen appears. Use perceive to read ids; attempt with expect after each tap.

action.summary: Perceive initial onboarding screen to read available affordances.

action.label: Continue
action.summary: Tap Continue to advance onboarding to the next screen; expect the Skip affordance on the following screen.

hypotheses.detail: expected OnboardSkip, saw similar: OnboardNameField, OnboardNameTitle, OnboardNext
expected OnboardSkip, saw similar: OnboardNameField, OnboardNameTitle, OnboardNext

action.summary: Perceive current onboarding screen after failed Continue tap; read available affordances (OnboardNameField, OnboardNext).

action.label: Name
action.summary: Type the user's name into the OnboardNameField; then next step will likely be tapping Next.

action.label: Next
action.summary: Tap Next to proceed from the Name entry screen to the next onboarding step; expect the next screen's primary action to be available.

hypotheses.detail: expected OnboardNext, saw similar: OnboardAlmostDone, OnboardFinish
expected OnboardNext, saw similar: OnboardAlmostDone, OnboardFinish

action.summary: Perceive current onboarding screen to read available affordances; identify OnboardFinish as the next tap target to complete onboarding.

action.label: Finish
action.summary: Tap Finish to complete onboarding; expect the home-ready screen to appear.

hypotheses.detail: expected Home, saw similar: HomeReady, HomeUserName
expected Home, saw similar: HomeReady, HomeUserName

action.summary: Onboarding completed; home-ready screen detected with HomeReady and HomeUserName visible.

result.summary: Onboarding completed; home-ready screen detected with HomeReady and HomeUserName visible.
